title: World Trade Report 2026: AI, services, and cross-border spillovers
discussion_signal: The post links AI and digital services to possible trade expansion while emphasizing new cross-border spillovers from privacy, cybersecurity, competition, and AI governance differences. It frames flexibility and integration as dependent on common rules and interoperability, not only technology.
linked_research_question: How do AI, digital services, and divergent rules reshape trade integration, flexibility, and geopolitical spillovers?
limits: Professional interpretation of a WTO report
